verdict.rationale: Pipeline CRM's pricing page offers data import assistance from an Onboarding Manager as part of guided setup, so some vendor-provided migration help exists. Nothing documents importing from another CRM specifically, or preserving record owners and activity history. The REST API is only a developer building block and earns no credit. Missing for 10: a documented CRM-to-CRM import tool or path, preservation of record owners, preservation of activity and history, any independent or hands-on corroboration of migration fidelity.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can migrate from another CRM with my records, owners, and history intact

citations.quote: Guided setup, data import assistance, and one-on-one training by a Pipeline Onboarding Manager.
